description: This file defines the main game screen widget for a Tic Tac Toe app built with Flutter. It manages game state, user interactions, rendering the game board, and UI elements like controls and status messages.

classes.name: GameScreen
classes.description: Main gameplay screen widget that displays the game board, status, and controls.

classes.name: _GameScreenState
classes.description: State class managing the game logic, UI updates, and user interactions for GameScreen.

methods.name: __resetBoard
methods.description: Resets the game state to start a new game.

methods.name: _evaluateBoard
methods.description: Checks for a winner or draw after each move and updates game state.

methods.name: _onTapCell
methods.description: Handles user's tap on a cell, updates game state accordingly.

methods.name: _statusText
methods.description: Returns appropriate status message based on current game state.

methods.name: _statusAccent
methods.description: Returns color for status text depending on game state.

methods.name: _isWinningCell
methods.description: Determines if a cell is part of the winning line.

methods.name: _buildBoard
methods.description: Builds the 3x3 grid of game tiles.
